In this masterclass you compare Deccan temple forms without rigid typological simplifications.

Length, level and language are agreed with you. It can be given online or at your venue, as a single session or as part of a series.

What it covers

  • Pattadakal types
  • Aihole/Badami
  • Terminology debate

How the time is spent

  1. Pattadakal types 30 min

    Compare northern and southern forms at one ensemble.

    You: trace plans

  2. Aihole/Badami 60 min

    Identify experiments in built form and dating.

    You: evidence cards

  3. Terminology debate 30 min

    Discuss why Vesara is contested; introduce Karnata Dravida.

    You: critique labels

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Compare northern and southern temple forms within the single ensemble at Pattadakal.
  • Identify experiments in built form and dating at Aihole and Badami.
  • Explain why the label Vesara is contested and recognise the term Karnata Dravida.
